title: KAFKA-21240: KRaftMetadataCache should cache metadata request information per image
body:
### What Changed

- Updates `KRaftMetadataRequest` benchmark to more accurately represent
a real scenario by making replica and leader placements random. Also
adds a JBOD case where brokers have >= 1 directory.
- Gets the leader id for a `MetadataResponsePartition` without
constructing a `Node` object.
- `BrokerRegistration`'s in-memory object now maintains a hash set of
online directories so that `BrokerRegistration.hasOnlineDir` no longer
requires a binary search. The previous code is a regression from
ZooKeeper Kafka and can impact performance in JBOD deployments.

### Benchmarking

```
./jmh-benchmarks/jmh.sh -p topicCount=500 -p partitionCount=50 -p
logDirsPerBroker=1,16 -f 10 -prof gc
KRaftMetadataRequestBenchmark.testMetadataRequestForAllTopics
```

```
  ┌──────────────────┬─────────┬──────────────┬──────────────┐
  │ logDirsPerBroker │  trunk  │   this PR    │    change    │
  ├──────────────────┼─────────┼──────────────┼──────────────┤
  │ 1                │ 2.20 ms │ 1.57–1.65 ms │ −25% to −29% │
  ├──────────────────┼─────────┼──────────────┼──────────────┤
  │ 16               │ 3.52 ms │ 2.50 ms      │ −29%         │
  └──────────────────┴─────────┴──────────────┴──────────────┘
```
